name: JMS Eventstream connector
description: Eventstream now supports a Java Message Service source connector, extending coverage to another widely used message broker type. Teams running JMS brokers can stream those messages into Microsoft Fabric for real-time analytics.With this capability, you can:- Connect Eventstream to Java Message Service brokers.- Stream JMS messages into Fabric destinations.- Process broker data with no-code operators or SQL operators.

result.descriptionEs: Eventstream admitirá un conector de origen Java Message Service (JMS) para transmitir mensajes de brokers JMS a Fabric y procesarlos con operadores sin código o SQL.
